I added a 0.25-second sleep after each sandbox call in `tests/test_payments.py`. The 5 requests/second limit means calls need to be at least 0.2s apart, so 0.25s leaves a little room. The value is stored in a named constant, `SANDBOX_CALL_INTERVAL`, with a comment explaining the limit.

I haven't run the test. It's an integration test that calls the external sandbox, so I can't confirm here that the flakes are gone; the next CI runs will show that.

The test adds about 1 second in total, including one unneeded sleep after the last call. If the suite grows, a fixture that throttles all calls to the sandbox would be cleaner than sleeping in each loop.

I also saved the sandbox's 5 requests/second limit to the project's memory, so future tests that call the sandbox will take it into account.
